annotations.title: Run a write tool by name

description: Runs one tool that changes something (publish, sign, send, revoke and the like) by its name with its arguments, exactly as calling it directly does: the same sign-in, scopes and approvals, and a person's approval where the tool asks for one. Use it for a write tool search_tools or enable_toolset named that your client does not list. A read-only tool runs through call_tool.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, as its input schema asks.

name.description: The write tool's name, as search_tools gives it.

name: call_write_tool
title: Run a tool that changes something, by name
